verdict.rationale: Airwallex's own refunds documentation confirms that merchants can issue refunds to return shopper funds, so the core capability exists. The evidence is a single thin line that does not say whether refunds can be partial or full, or whether they can be issued from the dashboard, the API, or both. Missing for 10: evidence of partial vs. full refund amounts, evidence of dashboard-initiated refunds, evidence of an API refund endpoint, independent or hands-on corroboration.
